import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
import json
s=json.load(open('/app/output/spec.json'))
axes=np.array(s['proprio']['axis']); points=np.array(s['proprio']['position_m'])
def trans(axis,point,q):
 R=Rot.from_rotvec(axis*q).as_matrix(); T=np.eye(4); T[:3,:3]=R;T[:3,3]=point-R@point;return T
def arm(q):
 T=np.eye(4)
 for i,a in zip([11,12,13,14],q): T=T@trans(axes[i],points[i],a)
 E=np.eye(4);E[:3,3]=points[14];return T@E
T0=arm([0,3.11,0,1.49])
def solve(theta,prev=None):
 def fun(v):
  x,z,p,roll,yaw,e=v
  B=np.eye(4);B[:3,:3]=Rot.from_rotvec([0,theta,0]).as_matrix();B[:3,3]=[x,0,z]
  T=B@arm([p,roll,yaw,e])
  return np.r_[3*(T[:3,3]-T0[:3,3]),Rot.from_matrix(T0[:3,:3].T@T[:3,:3]).as_rotvec()]
 v0=[0,0,0,3.11,0,1.49] if prev is None else prev
 res=least_squares(fun,v0,max_nfev=100)
 return res.x,np.linalg.norm(res.fun)
if __name__=='__main__':
 v=None
 for t in np.linspace(0,3.14,21):
  v,err=solve(t,v); print(round(t,2),np.round(v,3),err)
